reasons.claim: Four tahwil branches with two co-transmitters in the fourth branch meet at the shared tail beginning with Shu'ba and ending at Abd Allah, with the gloss omitted.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن شعبة، عن الأعمش، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters open the chain and converge on Sa'd ibn Abd Allah, continuing through Bashir al-Dahan (one link with his relation phrase) to Abu Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه، ومحمد بن الحسن، وأحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار رضي الله عنهم قالوا: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Yahya ibn Yahya through Malik, Nafi', and Abd Allah ibn Umar to Hafsa, who asks the Prophet and relays his answer.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع، عن عبد الله بن عمر، أن حفصة،

reasons.claim: The chain runs from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan through Abu Khadija and closes with the Imam named in the words after the chain, copied as written.
reasons.quote: الفضل بن شاذان، عن الحسن بن علي الوشاء، عن أحمد بن عائذ، عن أبي خديجة قال: قال أبوعبد الله عليه السلام:

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna through the bare name Muhammad, Shu'ba, Ziyad ibn Fayyad, and Abu Iyad to Abd Allah ibn Amr.
reasons.quote: عن زياد بن فياض، سمعت أبا عياض، يحدث عن عبد الله بن عمرو، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال له

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Yahya ibn Yahya through Malik, Abd Allah ibn Yazid (with his mawla phrase), and Abu Salama ibn Abd al-Rahman to Abu Hurayra, who relays the Prophet's prostration.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن عبد الله بن يزيد، مولى الأسود بن سفيان عن أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، أن أبا هريرة،

reviews.question: first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker

reasons.claim: Both readers accurately record the written chain through Abu al-Yaman, Shu'ayb, and al-Zuhri to the back reference «بهذا» (with no previous report supplied in the packet), which holds regardless of how the unnamed first-person speaker is ruled.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو اليمان، أخبرنا شعيب، عن الزهري، بهذا

reasons.claim: The narrative continues with an unnamed female first-person speaker, which touches the unruled question on unnamed first-person speakers.
reasons.quote: قالت وأحزنني فنمت، فرأيت لعثمان عينا تجري،

reviews.question: fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first route runs from Adam through Shu'ba, Amr, and Abu al-Bakhtari al-Ta'i to Ibn Abbas, while the anonymous men in the scene are not links.
reasons.quote: حدثنا آدم، حدثنا شعبة، أخبرنا عمرو، قال سمعت أبا البختري الطائي، قال سألت ابن عباس

reasons.claim: Under working rule 11, the fully written second chain after the text ending in «مثله» is a route of this saying, matching both readers.
reasons.quote: وقال معاذ حدثنا شعبة، عن عمرو، قال أبو البختري سمعت ابن عباس  رضى الله عنهما  نهى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثله‏.‏

reasons.claim: The chain runs from the compiler's father through Mansur ibn Yunus to two co-transmitters (Sulayman ibn [Za'id and an unnamed co-transmitter) and ends at Abu Abd Allah named after the chain.
reasons.quote: عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بن [زائد مَوْلَى طِرْبَالٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches each split into three co-transmitters and meet at the shared tail Anas, yielding six routes.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن أنس، سمعوه يقول سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول
